## Findings

### Anti-patterns

- God function: <module> in scripts/verify-pages.mjs calls 143 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [critical]
- God function: Scene in packages/react/src/scene-root.tsx calls 108 unique functions — consider decomposing into smaller, focused functions [critical]
- check and core-document form a circular dependency (core-document→check: 8, check→core-document: 3): core-document needs check's validation logic while check needs core-document's types, so neither can sit cleanly above the other — the shared pieces each side actually needs should move to a module both can depend on downward. [warning] (check)

### Patterns

- core-graph and core-document are mutually dependent (core-document→core-graph: 37, core-graph→core-document: 6): core-graph cannot be treated as a foundational layer core-document simply builds on, since a handful of its own files reach back up into core-document — isolating those 6 imports (likely type-only) would let core-graph become acyclic. [warning] (core-graph)
- document and core-document circularly depend on each other (core-document→document: 27, document→core-document: 14); combined with document↔core-graph and document↔findings crossings, the four zones (core-document, core-graph, document, findings) behave as one tangled module rather than a layered architecture — a maintainer changing any one risks rippling through all four. [warning] (document)
- findings, document and core-document are mutually circular (findings→core-document: 14 / core-document→findings: 28, findings→document: 3 / document→findings: 2) — the three are effectively one concept split across directories by filename convention, and the cycle makes it hard to change compile-checked.ts or findings.ts without touching document.ts and vice versa; merging them under packages/core/src/document/findings/ would make the real dependency direction visible instead of circular. [warning] (findings)

### Relationships

- Tightly coupled modules: packages/studio/src/edits.ts and packages/studio/src/source.ts — 57 cross-file calls (unidirectional). Consider extracting shared interface or merging [info]

- 18 entry points — wide API surface, consider consolidating exports [warning] (apps)

- ... and 63 more

### Suggestions

- Zone "apps" has files across 23 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (apps)
- Zone "core" has files across 6 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (core)
- Zone "Core" is severely fragile and needs immediate architectural intervention — cohesion: 0.23, coupling: 0.77 (risk score: 0.77) [critical] (core)
- Zone "core-document" has files across 15 directories — consider consolidating under a dedicated directory [info] (core-document)
